title: NEMAR Extension
description: NEMAR-specific properties that extend the core schema. Includes fields from the NEMAR API and nemar.json that are not part of the universal core.

on_brainlife.description: Whether the dataset is available on BrainLife.

has_visualization.description: Whether NEMAR has generated visualizations for this dataset.

nemar_json.description: Contents of the nemar.json file (warnings, plots, channel system info).

local_dataset.description: Whether a local copy of the dataset is maintained by NEMAR.

processed.description: Whether NEMAR has processed this dataset.

hed_annotation.description: Whether the dataset has HED annotations (from NEMAR processing).

citation_count.description: Number of papers citing this dataset (from NEMAR citations repository).
